move: swoosh outline draws along the curve, white flood chases it, gold glint runs the top edge, letters kick in
how: An SVG swoosh-like curve: an outline path, a rect flood clipped to the shape, and a gold glint path along the top edge, plus four letter spans. 0-42%: the outline drawSVGs 0->100% (power3.inOut). At 30% the flood rect width grows 0->720 left to right with power3.out over 0.32s, filling the shape white as it chases the stroke; at 45% the stroke fades out. At 50% the glint draws as a 30%-long segment sliding to the end of the curve (drawSVG '0% 0%' -> '70% 100%', power2.in) and blinks off at 80%. Meanwhile the whole SVG settles from rotation -6 scale .92 with expo.out from 30%, and at 55% the letters C-U-R-V rise from yPercent 120 with a 0.05s stagger (expo.out). Exit at 88%: the mark whips up 30px and fades (power3.in) and the letters fade with a 0.015s stagger.
adapt: Replace the three paths with the product's own curved mark (outline, clip shape, top edge), the word letters and the gold (#ffcf3a). Keep the 0.42s draw, the flood starting at 30% and the 0.05s letter stagger.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the SVG with a uniquely-id'd clipPath and the letter spans inside el; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with draw 0-0.42D, flood at 0.3D, glint at 0.5D, letters at 0.55D, exit at 0.88D. Register DrawSVGPlugin; rename the clipPath id and scope selectors to el; the flood width 720 is in viewBox units and ports unchanged.
caveats: clipPath id 'c' is global and must be unique per instance
one second total; the letter from() needs immediateRender:false when nested
ends empty, no return to frame one
